title: Removal of Foreign Emigrants Bengal Amendment Ordinance 2001

sections.shortTitle: Removal of Foreign Emigrants Bengal Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XL OF 2001
ORDINANCE XL OF 2001
REMOVAL OF FOREIGN
EMIGRANTS (BENGAL)
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
An Ordinance further
to amend the Removal of Foreign
Emigrants (Bengal)
Regulation, 1812.
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary,,
30th October, 2001]
No.Legis.2‑42/Law/79/IV,
dated ‑ 30‑10‑2001.----The following Ordinance made by the
Governor of Balochistan on 27th October, 2001, is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement. ‑‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the
Removal of Foreign Emigrants (Bengal) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force on
the 14th day of August, 2001.

sections.shortTitle: Removal of Foreign Emigrants Bengal Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Amendment of section 3 of Regulation XI of 1812

ORDINANCE XL OF 2001
ORDINANCE XL OF 2001
REMOVAL OF FOREIGN
EMIGRANTS (BENGAL)
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
An Ordinance further
to amend the Removal of Foreign
Emigrants (Bengal)
Regulation, 1812.
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary,,
30th October, 2001]
No.Legis.2‑42/Law/79/IV,
dated ‑ 30‑10‑2001.----The following Ordinance made by the
Governor of Balochistan on 27th October, 2001, is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
2. Amendment of section 3 of
Regulation XI of 1812.‑‑‑In the Balochistan Removal of
Foreign Emigrant (Bengal) Regulation, 1812, in section 3, for the word
"Collector" the words "Executive District Officer
(Revenue)" shall be substituted.
